reviews.title: Useless for teleprompting
reviews.text: I downloaded and paid for this app to use with my iPad on a teleprompter and it simply doesn’t work. It’s not possible to change the scroll centring position (which needs to be where the camera lens is), rendering it useless. Otherwise it looks like I’m staring at the ceiling not the camera when reading it.

reviews.title: Cool idea, but buggy
reviews.text: I have this app on my phone and it works great, but when I purchased it to help me record podcasts, it’s real buggy. The voice scroll feature does not work at all.

reviews.title: Old keyboard
reviews.text: total rip off. It says it has a mirror and gives you the impression you can record your face and vocals while reading the script. Then you find out you have to pay $35 for an additional add-on per year to get what you originally want. You don't own it. You're just rent it total Scam now they won't give me back the 20 bucks I spent on the bait app. There are others where you spend 50 bucks and you get to keep it

reviews.title: Amazing for zoom, not for recording on phone
reviews.text: I love this teleprompter. The voice scrolling is better than any teleprompter I have used. The low rating is because I cannot self-record on my phone with the teleprompter. I thought it was could when it said on the website that I could use it from my phone. Otherwise, it’s great for zoom calls and online workshops.
